statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
Symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
Patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring was ordered
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The service is needed to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The service is needed to capture arrhythmic episodes during daily activities
A single-office ECG cannot achieve the clinical goal
The service is medically necessary to guide management of the underlying arrhythmia
The denial reason code is CO-97
